observations.behavior: Refactored the banner rendering from a JSX fragment to a ternary expression, removing the wrapper and its dependency on taskId and runId. This could reduce unnecessary re-renders of the banner subtree when the parent list header updates, while retaining the same conditional rendering behavior.
observations.posthog_connection: Desktop mobile app: Task session view. The banner displays terminal status and error recovery. Removing taskId and runId dependencies could prevent the banner from re-rendering unnecessarily when the parent list updates, potentially improving perceived performance during live session updates.
